# JIIT Youth Club

JIIT Youth Club (JYC) is the student-led campus ecosystem for JIIT Sector 128, Noida.

## Public routes
- / — JYC home
- /clubs — published clubs and communities
- /events — published events
- /gallery — published visual archive
- /team — published JYC team
- /discover — interest-based club discovery using published metadata
- /calendar — JYC and academic calendar views
- /recruitment — published recruitment opportunities
- /auditions — published auditions
- /my-jyc — saved clubs/events and account-linked registrations
- /fest-pass — public digital fest pass
- /map — published campus venues
- /certificates — public certificate verification
- /download — self-hosting and source access
- /moments — editorial campus archive
- /agenda — saved-event personal agenda and calendar export
- /projects — projects published by JYC clubs
- /achievements — achievements published by JYC clubs
- /settings — device performance and motion preferences

Only content published by JYC administrators should be treated as official. Empty states indicate that no corresponding official content has been published yet.
